description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-TYPE: What Decimal values are stored in FD (x DECIMAL(28,4) made by ADO DDL; intended groups g1 [9999999999999.9999, 0.0001, -0.0001]; g2 [9999999999999.9999, 1, -1]; g3 [-1, 1, 9999999999999.9999]; g4 [0.1, 0.2, 0.3]; g5 [99999999999999999, 1, -99999999999999999]; g6 [79228162514264337593543950335, 1, -1]; g7 [1.00000000000000000001, 1]; g8 [0.5, 0.5]), and what does Sum return (Field type, size, Precision and Scale properties, value, or error and call) per group (WHERE g = 1 to 8), over all rows, and as GROUP BY g? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.
retentionNote: Designed r-par-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
